name: list-incidents
title: Incidents
description: Lists the incidents of a queue with their priority, state and assignee.

state.description: new, assigned, on hold, resolved or closed

name: get-incident
title: Incident
description: Returns an incident with its caller, notes, attachments and history.

name: open-incident
title: Open an incident
description: Opens an incident for a caller with a short description and a category.

name: assign-incident
title: Assign an incident
description: Assigns an incident to an agent or a support group.

name: escalate-incident
title: Escalate an incident
description: Escalates an incident to the next support level and notifies its manager.

name: set-incident-priority
title: Incident priority
description: Sets the impact and urgency of an incident, which give its priority.

name: hold-incident
title: Put an incident on hold
description: Puts an incident on hold while waiting for the caller or a vendor.

name: resolve-incident
title: Resolve an incident
description: Marks an incident resolved with a resolution code and notes for the caller.

name: close-incident
title: Close an incident
description: Closes a resolved incident once the caller confirmed the fix.

name: reopen-incident
title: Reopen an incident
description: Reopens a resolved or closed incident when the issue comes back.

name: merge-incidents
title: Merge incidents
description: Merges duplicate incidents into one, keeping the notes of each.

name: add-incident-note
title: Note on an incident
description: Adds a work note or a comment visible to the caller on an incident.

visible.description: true for a comment the caller sees

name: link-incident-problem
title: Link to a problem
description: Links an incident to the problem record that causes it.

name: list-major-incidents
title: Major incidents
description: Lists the major incidents in progress with their bridge call and communications.

name: declare-major-incident
title: Declare a major incident
description: Declares an incident major, opens a bridge call and pages the incident manager.

name: list-problems
title: Problems
description: Lists the problem records with their state, known error flag and linked incidents.

name: get-problem
title: Problem
description: Returns a problem record with its root cause, workaround and linked incidents.

name: open-problem
title: Open a problem
description: Opens a problem record to investigate the cause of repeated incidents.

name: assign-problem
title: Assign a problem
description: Assigns a problem record to an analyst for investigation.

name: record-root-cause
title: Root cause
description: Records the root cause found for a problem.

name: publish-workaround
title: Publish a workaround
description: Publishes a workaround for a known error so agents can apply it to incidents.

name: close-problem
title: Close a problem
description: Closes a problem record once the permanent fix is in place.

name: list-known-errors
title: Known errors
description: Lists the known errors with their workaround, for agents answering calls.

name: list-changes
title: Changes
description: Lists the change requests with their type, risk, state and planned window.

name: get-change
title: Change
description: Returns a change request with its plan, risk assessment, approvals and tasks.

name: request-change
title: Request a change
description: Creates a change request with its plan, backout plan and planned window.

name: assess-change-risk
title: Change risk
description: Computes the risk of a change from its answers to the risk questions.

name: submit-change
title: Submit a change
description: Submits a change request for approval by the change advisory board.

name: approve-change
title: Approve a change
description: Records the approval of a change request by an approver.

name: reject-change
title: Reject a change
description: Rejects a change request and sends it back to its owner with a reason.

name: schedule-change
title: Schedule a change
description: Sets the planned window of an approved change.

name: start-change
title: Start a change
description: Marks a change as being implemented at the start of its window.

name: complete-change
title: Complete a change
description: Closes a change as successful, partly successful or failed after its implementation.

name: roll-back-change
title: Roll back a change
description: Records that a change was backed out and opens a review.

name: cancel-change
title: Cancel a change
description: Cancels a change request that will not be implemented.

name: list-change-conflicts
title: Change conflicts
description: Lists the changes whose windows overlap on the same configuration items.

name: get-change-calendar
title: Change calendar
description: Returns the calendar of planned changes and freeze windows for a period.

name: add-freeze-window
title: Freeze window
description: Adds a period during which no change may be implemented.

name: list-cab-meetings
title: CAB meetings
description: Lists the change advisory board meetings with their agenda.

name: list-service-requests
title: Service requests
description: Lists the service requests with their catalogue item, requester and state.

name: get-service-request
title: Service request
description: Returns a service request with its items, approvals and fulfilment tasks.

name: raise-service-request
title: Raise a service request
description: Raises a request for a catalogue item on behalf of a user.

name: approve-service-request
title: Approve a service request
description: Approves a service request waiting for the manager of the requester.

name: reject-service-request
title: Reject a service request
description: Rejects a service request with a reason for the requester.

name: fulfil-service-request
title: Fulfil a service request
description: Marks a service request fulfilled and tells the requester.

name: cancel-service-request
title: Cancel a service request
description: Cancels a service request the requester no longer needs.

name: list-catalogue-items
title: Catalogue items
description: Lists the items of the service catalogue with their category and approval rule.

name: get-catalogue-item
title: Catalogue item
description: Returns a catalogue item with its form, approvals and delivery time.

name: create-catalogue-item
title: Create a catalogue item
description: Adds an item to the service catalogue with its form and fulfilment group.

name: update-catalogue-form
title: Catalogue item form
description: Changes the questions of the form a user fills in to request a catalogue item.

name: retire-catalogue-item
title: Retire a catalogue item
description: Removes an item from the catalogue so it can no longer be requested.

name: list-tasks
title: Tasks
description: Lists the tasks of incidents, changes and requests assigned to an agent or group.

name: get-task
title: Task
description: Returns a task with its parent record, assignee and work notes.

name: create-task
title: Create a task
description: Adds a task to an incident, a change or a request.

name: assign-task
title: Assign a task
description: Assigns a task to an agent or a group.

name: complete-task
title: Complete a task
description: Marks a task done with its work notes.

name: list-assets
title: Assets
description: Lists the hardware assets with their model, serial number, owner and state.

state.description: in stock, in use, in repair or retired

name: get-asset
title: Asset
description: Returns an asset with its owner, location, warranty and history.

name: register-asset
title: Register an asset
description: Registers a new hardware asset with its model, serial number and purchase date.

name: assign-asset
title: Assign an asset
description: Gives an asset to a user and records the handover.

name: return-asset
title: Return an asset
description: Records that a user gave an asset back to stock.

name: send-asset-to-repair
title: Send an asset to repair
description: Sends an asset to repair with the vendor under its warranty.

name: retire-asset
title: Retire an asset
description: Retires an asset, with the reason and how it was disposed of.

name: transfer-asset
title: Transfer an asset
description: Moves an asset to another location or cost centre.

name: list-expiring-warranties
title: Expiring warranties
description: Lists the assets whose warranty ends within a number of days.

name: start-asset-audit
title: Asset audit
description: Starts a stock count of the assets of a location against what is recorded.

name: list-software-licences
title: Software licences
description: Lists the software licences with their seats, seats in use and renewal date.

name: get-software-licence
title: Software licence
description: Returns a licence with its agreement, seats and the users holding them.

name: allocate-licence-seat
title: Allocate a licence seat
description: Gives a seat of a software licence to a user.

name: reclaim-licence-seat
title: Reclaim a licence seat
description: Takes back a seat from a user who no longer uses the software.

name: renew-software-licence
title: Renew a licence
description: Records the renewal of a software licence with its new end date and seats.

name: list-unused-licence-seats
title: Unused seats
description: Lists the seats held by users who did not open the software for a number of days.

name: list-config-items
title: Configuration items
description: Lists the configuration items of the CMDB with their class and status.

class.description: Class, for example server or application

name: get-config-item
title: Configuration item
description: Returns a configuration item with its attributes and relationships.

name: add-config-item
title: Add a configuration item
description: Adds a configuration item to the CMDB.

name: relate-config-items
title: Relate configuration items
description: Records that one configuration item depends on or runs on another.

name: unrelate-config-items
title: Remove a relationship
description: Removes a relationship between two configuration items.

name: get-impact-analysis
title: Impact analysis
description: Lists the services and users affected if a configuration item goes down.

name: list-services
title: Business services
description: Lists the business services with their owner, hours and current health.

name: get-service-health
title: Service health
description: Returns the health of a business service from its open incidents and monitoring.

name: list-knowledge-articles
title: Knowledge articles
description: Lists the articles of the knowledge base with their state, views and rating.

name: search-knowledge
title: Search the knowledge base
description: Finds published articles whose words match a question.

name: get-knowledge-article
title: Knowledge article
description: Returns an article with its body, versions and feedback.

name: draft-knowledge-article
title: Draft an article
description: Writes a new knowledge article as a draft, optionally from a resolved incident.

name: submit-article-review
title: Send an article for review
description: Sends a draft article to its knowledge manager for review.

name: publish-knowledge-article
title: Publish an article
description: Publishes a reviewed article so users and agents can read it.

name: retire-knowledge-article
title: Retire an article
description: Takes an article out of the knowledge base when it is out of date.

name: translate-knowledge-article
title: Translate an article
description: Adds a version of an article in another language.

name: list-article-feedback
title: Article feedback
description: Lists the ratings and comments users left on articles.

name: list-slas
title: SLAs
description: Lists the service level agreements with their targets for response and resolution.

name: get-sla
title: SLA
description: Returns an SLA with its targets, schedule and the records it applies to.

name: create-sla
title: Create an SLA
description: Defines a service level agreement with its targets and business hours.

name: pause-sla-clock
title: Pause the SLA clock
description: Pauses the SLA timer of a record while waiting for the caller.

name: list-sla-breaches
title: SLA breaches
description: Lists the records that breached or are about to breach their SLA.

name: list-queues
title: Queues
description: Lists the support queues with their open records and members.

name: create-queue
title: Create a queue
description: Creates a support queue with its working hours.

name: add-queue-member
title: Add to a queue
description: Adds an agent to a support queue.

name: remove-queue-member
title: Remove from a queue
description: Removes an agent from a support queue.

name: set-routing-rule
title: Routing rule
description: Sets the rule that sends new records of a category to a queue.

name: list-users
title: Users
description: Lists the users of the directory with their department, manager and status.

name: get-user
title: User
description: Returns a user with their devices, open records and groups.

name: create-user
title: Create a user
description: Creates a user account for a new starter.

name: deactivate-user
title: Deactivate a user
description: Disables the account of a user who leaves and lists what they still hold.

name: reset-user-password
title: Reset a password
description: Resets the password of a user and sends a temporary one.

name: unlock-user-account
title: Unlock an account
description: Unlocks an account locked after too many failed sign-ins.

name: set-out-of-office
title: Out of office
description: Marks an agent away so no record is routed to them.

name: list-groups
title: Groups
description: Lists the support groups with their manager and members.

name: create-group
title: Create a group
description: Creates a support group with its manager.

name: add-group-member
title: Add to a group
description: Adds a user to a support group.

name: remove-group-member
title: Remove from a group
description: Removes a user from a support group.

name: get-on-call-rota
title: On-call rota
description: Returns who is on call for a group, today or on a date.

name: swap-on-call-shift
title: Swap on-call shifts
description: Swaps two on-call shifts between agents of a group.

name: page-on-call
title: Page on call
description: Pages the agent on call for a group by phone and text message.

name: post-announcement
title: Post an announcement
description: Posts a banner on the portal about an outage or planned work.

name: list-announcements
title: Announcements
description: Lists the banners shown on the portal.

name: withdraw-announcement
title: Withdraw an announcement
description: Takes a banner off the portal.

name: send-satisfaction-survey
title: Send a survey
description: Sends the satisfaction survey of a resolved record to its caller.

name: get-survey-results
title: Survey results
description: Returns the satisfaction scores and comments for a period.

name: report-incident-volume
title: Incident volume
description: Counts the incidents opened per day, category and priority over a period.

name: report-sla-compliance
title: SLA compliance
description: Returns the share of records that met their SLA, per group and priority.

name: report-agent-workload
title: Agent workload
description: Returns the open records and the time logged of each agent.

name: report-backlog-age
title: Backlog age
description: Counts the open records by how long they have been open.

name: report-first-call-resolution
title: First call resolution
description: Returns the share of incidents resolved on first contact.

name: list-canned-responses
title: Canned responses
description: Lists the saved replies agents can insert in a comment.

name: create-canned-response
title: Create a canned response
description: Saves a reply agents can insert in a comment.

name: apply-canned-response
title: Use a canned response
description: Adds a saved reply as a comment on a record, filled with its fields.

name: list-automation-rules
title: Automation rules
description: Lists the rules that act on records when they are created or change.

name: create-automation-rule
title: Create an automation rule
description: Creates a rule that acts on records that meet its conditions.

name: enable-automation-rule
title: Enable a rule
description: Turns an automation rule on.

name: disable-automation-rule
title: Disable a rule
description: Turns an automation rule off without deleting it.

name: delete-automation-rule
title: Delete a rule
description: Deletes an automation rule.

name: list-mailboxes
title: Mailboxes
description: Lists the e-mail inboxes that turn messages into records.

name: connect-mailbox
title: Connect a mailbox
description: Connects an e-mail inbox so its messages open records.

name: disconnect-mailbox
title: Disconnect a mailbox
description: Stops turning the messages of an inbox into records.

name: log-time
title: Log time
description: Logs time spent by an agent on a record.

name: list-time-entries
title: Time entries
description: Lists the time logged on records by agent and day.

name: list-departments
title: Departments
description: Lists the departments with their head and cost centre.

name: list-locations
title: Locations
description: Lists the offices and sites with their address and local support group.

name: list-vendors
title: Vendors
description: Lists the vendors with their contracts and support contacts.

name: get-vendor
title: Vendor
description: Returns a vendor with its contracts, contacts and open vendor tickets.

name: raise-vendor-ticket
title: Raise a vendor ticket
description: Opens a ticket with a vendor for an incident or an asset under contract.

name: list-releases
title: Releases
description: Lists the releases with the changes they bundle and their deployment date.

name: plan-release
title: Plan a release
description: Creates a release that bundles changes for one deployment.

name: deploy-release
title: Deploy a release
description: Records that a release was deployed to an environment.

name: list-maintenance-windows
title: Maintenance windows
description: Lists the agreed windows when a service may be taken down for work.

name: get-record-history
title: Record history
description: Returns who changed what on any record, field by field.

name: list-approvals
title: Approvals
description: Lists the changes and requests waiting for the approval of a user.

name: delegate-approvals
title: Delegate approvals
description: Lets another user approve in the name of an approver for a period.

name: list-incident-categories
title: Incident categories
description: Lists the categories and subcategories an incident can be filed under.

name: export-records
title: Export records
description: Exports the records of a list to a CSV file.
